36. Which of the following was the first official
postage stamp issued in Asia (in 1852) by the
British East India Company in the province of
Sindh?
questions.explanation_english:
The Scinde Dawk was the first official postage
stamp issued in Asia, introduced in July 1852 by
Sir Bartle Frere, the Commissioner of the Sindh
province in British India. Embossed on circular
red sealing wax, paper, or white wafers, the
stamps replaced the ancient runner system with
an organized postal rate. They represented a
major milestone in modernizing communication
systems across the subcontinent.
